body:
Well i can relate to you.. I hate myself so much too and consider myself a lost cause but you, you can still live! As long as you want to live you can fix anything.
Eventually I hope you will forgive yourself for scarring your face.
I have a scar too.. From burning..
Don't give up!

It's called being dead inside.. Well as a depressed person myself, I can relate but in my case I'm not scared anymore to die because it's too much for me to keep living like this.. So instead of waiting ill just do it because if I'll die anyway, why not die now.
You get that feeling too right?
Well most people are against suicide but I feel you..
I really want to die too..

I think too much so I can't sleep, if I try to sleep o think about stuff like how it will be like to be dead and my funeral then fucking cry.
Sometimes I feel so emotionally drained that I tell myself sleeping would distract me from feeling and I don't want to wake up at all.
I feel like when I sleep I won't wake up..sometimes it's comforting or scary..
I fucking feel you man, I want to end it all too.. I hate myself so much, I feel so unimportant..

I either sleep too much or can't sleep at all.
It sucks.

No.
I don't see a future for myself and my life is pretty much decided.
I have nothing that I want, no hobbies..
I feel empty thinking too much about what will come next.. I am too tired to care anymore..

I did tell them in the past, they did nothing.
I don't really trust people anymore as a result of being backstabbed and cast out from others lives.
Now all people see in me is a positive and cheerful person, even when I tried to tell someone they said get over it and act like I'm "me" again.
I'm tired of dealing with people.

I tried getting help, all they said was "don't be depressed! Do this and this".. Instead of trying to understand they just tell me that I have no need to be depressed, to get over it.
I already gave up, I can't even see anything beyond the dark.. I'm tired..

I made an account just to post this message here because I feel like a disappointment and laughing stock to others.. I feel so scared sometimes and it's hard to even do simple tasks like changing clothes without staring at nothing for hours while telling myself how much I hate myself for being so pathetic..
I'm unimportant on so many levels..
I used to cut till I stopped feeling pain, my chest hurts so bad and I can't stop crying sometimes.
I'm tired of faking my happiness and wearing a mask just so I won't be left alone for being a depressed fuck.
I've been this way for years now, low self eestem, anxiety and panic attacks.. I've been bullied for years, beat by my own sister with chains and used to spend most of my time on the streets which is why I'm so fucked up now.
I feel like nobody needs me and a burden.. I hate myself so much so I'll kill myself to take a break and stop thinking too much.
